title: Atlantian
summary: ATLAN'TIAN, ATLAN'TIC, adjective [from Atlas or Atlantis.] Pertaining to that division of the ocean, which lies between Europe and Africa on the east and America on the west. ATLAN'TIC, noun The ocean

inlines.v: ATLAN'TIAN, ATLAN'TIC, adjective [from Atlas or Atlantis.] Pertaining to that division of the ocean, which lies between Europe and Africa on the east and America on the west. ATLAN'TIC, noun The ocean, or that part of the ocean, which is between Europe and Africa on the east and America on the west.
